title: Bakersfield to Sacramento on I-5: Stops and Exits
meta: Drive I-5 from Bakersfield to Sacramento via Kettleman City: exits 257 to 519, mapped gas, EV, food and lodging, rest areas and sights along the way.
intro: This guide follows I-5 north from exit 257 near Buttonwillow to exit 519 in Sacramento, through cotton country, the Kettleman Hills, Westlands farm country, Los Banos, Tracy, Stockton and the Delta's edge. Gas, EV chargers, food and lodging are listed from OpenStreetMap as mapped, not live, so check ahead before you count on a stop. Miles here are California exit numbers counting up from the Mexico border.

faq.q: Where are the rest areas on I-5 between Bakersfield and Sacramento?
faq.a: The data lists Buttonwillow Rest Area at mile 259.2, Coalinga-Avenal Rest Area at mile 320.2, John "Chuck" Erreca Rest Area at mile 385.9 and Westley Rest Area at mile 444.9, all serving both directions. Dos Amigos Vista Point is also listed at mile 390.0, with no direction stated.

faq.q: Where can I find gas, EV charging, food and lodging at Kettleman City on I-5?
faq.a: At exit 309 (CA 41, Kettleman City), the data lists 9 gas stations, Tesla Supercharger and Electrify America chargers, 16 food places and 2 lodging places including Best Western and Quality Inn. This is mapped data, not live.

faq.q: Which I-5 exits between Bakersfield and Sacramento have the most lodging listed?
faq.a: Exit 407 (CA 33, Santa Nella) lists 8 lodging places, including Best Western and Holiday Inn Express. Exit 476 (March Lane) in Stockton lists 7, including Hilton and Courtyard.

faq.q: What exit is Lost Hills on I-5?
faq.a: Lost Hills is at exit 278 (CA 46). The data lists 14 gas stations there, Electrify America and Tesla chargers, 11 food places and 2 lodging places, as mapped. Going north, Blackwells Corner is also at this exit, on the left.

faq.q: What can I see along I-5 near Stockton?
faq.a: I-5 runs through Stockton past the deepwater port and crosses the Calaveras River. Highway 4 heads east at exit 472 on the Crosstown Freeway, built in the early 1970s through part of Little Manila.
